method: Fixed calendar splits; production XGBoost parameters; uniform sample weights for all arms; identical clean test feature vectors; ML-only calibrated ranking (raw tiebreak), no rule/market blend or recommender gates. Official-dividend fixed-box ROI is hypothetical; races with zero/null finish positions excluded from settlement.
limitations: Historical data previously researched; not pristine forward evidence.
Not an exact production replay: October 8 artifact unavailable in inspected archives.
Does not isolate historical feature contamination: history helpers unchanged in every arm.
Top-five metrics count all tied horses at positions <=5; dead-heat sets can exceed five.
Uniform weighting differs from production row-index recency weights.
Exotic settlement omits refund modeling; zero/null-finish races conservatively excluded, but completely missing withdrawal records cannot be identified.
